r10g-v50-finite-cycle-integrated-v1.coverage_adequacy: One fresh seed-40200 pair through the real isolated Godot worker and independent reader: common V6 setup and 30-command BW5R-B prefix, then fresh V50 directly for no-kick or after native kick/passive descent/V20 recovery/V7 stance for kicked. This distinct R10G route covers baseline policy selection, current-body initialization, both role ownership transitions, complete planned four-foot cycle, all 120 stop commands, complete retained telemetry and independent replay. Both roles are required because the baseline integration has changed. Full task paths are required to cover delayed support release, finalization and settled stopping. Each child has its own bounded horizon; no equal-time effect estimate. V50 controller, DLL, motor limits, solver and contacts are unchanged. Old diagnostic evaluation and all incidental support losses remain retained. A complete valid negative is a development route result; no held-out, equivalence, robustness or release claim.
